title: GAO Report on How the Coast Guard Can Address Marine Firefighting Challenges
summary: The following is the Sept. 29, 2026, Government Accountability Office report, Coast Guard: Additional Action Needed to Address Marine Firefighting Challenges. From the Report Fires on vessels are extremely dangerous and difficult for firefighters to respond to. In 2023, a marine vessel fire resulted in the deaths of 2 firefighters. After this, the U.S. Coast Guard worked to address firefighting risks—but it could do more. For example, the Coast Guard works with local port officials, land-based firefighters, and others to make plans before fires occur.
